exposure: Gestational age at PPROM diagnosis (<24 weeks vs. ≥24 weeks)
Corticosteroid prophylaxis for fetal lung maturation
cohort: 134 pregnant women who experienced PPROM between 12 and 33 6/7 weeks of gestation at a tertiary hospital between September 1, 2018 and September 30, 2020.
finding: Expectant management of PPROM between 12 and 23 6/7 weeks of gestation resulted in a 33.3% neonatal survival rate, high risk of BPD and NEC among survivors, and no severe maternal risks.
